**Supported User Roles:**
- **Admin:** Full system access, user management, analytics
- **Doctor:** Medical diagnosis, patient review, report access

1. Submit email and password
2. Firebase validates credentials
3. User profile is retrieved from Firestore
4. JWT token is generated for subsequent requests
5. User role determines available endpoints

**Security Features:**
- Password complexity validation
- Account lockout protection
- Audit logging for login attempts

post.description:
Request a password reset email with a secure token. The email contains a link with a token that expires in 1 hour.

**Password Reset Flow:**
1. User submits email address
2. System generates secure random token
3. Token is hashed and stored in Firestore
4. Reset email is sent with token
5. User clicks link and submits new password with token
6. System validates token and updates password

**Security Features:**
- Token is SHA-256 hashed before storage
- Token expires in 1 hour
- Token can only be used once
- Rate limiting to prevent abuse
- Email existence is not revealed

Reset password using the token received via email. The token must be valid and not expired.

**Reset Process:**
1. Extract token from reset email link
2. User enters new password
3. Submit token and new password
4. System validates token (not expired, not used)
5. Password is updated in Firebase Auth
6. Token is marked as used
7. Confirmation email is sent

**Security Features:**
- Token must match hashed value in database
- Token must not be expired (1 hour limit)
- Token can only be used once
- Password strength validation

Exchange a refresh token for a new access token. Use this endpoint to maintain user sessions without requiring re-authentication.

1. Submit the refresh_token received from login

**Security Features:**
- Refresh tokens are long-lived but can be revoked
- Each refresh returns a new refresh token (rotation)
- Invalid or expired refresh tokens return 401

get.description:
Retrieve measurements with comprehensive filtering options. Results are always sorted by creation date (newest first).

**Access Control:**
- **Customer Role:** Only sees their own measurements
- **Doctor/Admin Role:** Can see all measurements in the system

- Patient name: Prefix matching (when used alone) or exact match (when combined with date filters)
- Patient ID: Exact match
- Measurement status (locked/unlocked)
- Diagnosis status (dx_locked)
- Date ranges (from_date, to_date)

- Offset-based pagination
- Maximum 100 records per request
- Default 50 records per page

- All results are automatically sorted by created_at in descending order (newest first)

post.description:
Upload fundus, OCT, or document images for retinal analysis and AI-powered disease detection.

**Supported Image Types:**
- **fundus:** Fundus photography (JPEG, PNG, TIFF) - Color retinal photographs for diabetic retinopathy, AMD screening
- **oct:** OCT scans (JPEG, PNG, TIFF, DICOM) - Optical coherence tomography for macular analysis
- **document:** Supporting documents (JPEG, PNG, TIFF, PDF) - Medical reports, consent forms, referral letters, etc. (no AI processing)

**Image Requirements:**
- **Format:** Varies by image type (see above)
- **Size:** Maximum 100MB per image
- **Upload Method:** Multipart form-data file upload
- **Quality:** Minimum 1024x768 resolution recommended for medical images

**AI Processing Pipeline (fundus & oct only):**
1. Image validation and format conversion
2. Upload to secure Firebase Storage
3. External AI inference processing
4. Risk score calculation (0-3 scale)
5. Classification confidence scores
6. Integration with measurement workflow

**Medical Classifications:**
- Diabetic Retinopathy stages
- Age-related Macular Degeneration
- Glaucomatous changes
- Hypertensive retinopathy
- Other retinal pathologies

get.description:
**Admin-only endpoint providing system-wide analytics**

**Default Time Range**: Last 30 days if from_date/to_date not specified

**Performance**: ~5 seconds response time (optimized with caching and parallelization for 20 users)

**Data Sections Returned:**

• **measurement_stats**: Measurement counts, completion rates, processing times
  - Filtered by measurements.created_at within query period
  - Optionally scoped to specific user_id

• **user_activity**: User engagement and growth metrics
  - total_users: ALL users in database (all-time, NOT filtered by period)
  - active_users: Users who created ≥1 measurement in query period
  - new_users: Users with account created_time in query period

• **diagnosis_metrics**: Doctor performance and diagnosis trends
  - Filtered by measurements.dx_date within query period (NOT created_at)
  - Requires composite Firestore index when user_id filter applied

• **usage_metrics**: Credit usage and billing data
  - Queries users/{userId}/credits collection for billing charges
  - Returns 0 if no billing charges found (even if measurements exist)
  - Charges created automatically when measurements are locked

• **email_metrics**: Email delivery statistics
  - Filtered by email_logs.sentAt within query period

• **system_statistics**: Revenue, growth trends, platform health
  - Includes 12-month trends (NOT limited to query period)
  - system_uptime always returns 99.9 (hardcoded, not calculated)

**Optional user_id parameter**: Scopes most metrics to specific user

**Important Notes:**
- Usage metrics depend on billing charges existing in Firestore
- If measurements exist but credits show 0, billing charges weren't created
- Default 30-day range may exclude older data
- Date boundary uses <= (inclusive) for to_date

get.description:
**Customer-scoped metrics showing personal activity and credit usage**

**Default Time Range**: Last 30 days if from_date/to_date not specified

**Access Control**: Customers only see their own data (filtered by authenticated user.uid)

**Calculation Method:**
- Queries measurements where user_id = authenticated user
- Filters by created_at within query period
- Excludes deleted measurements (deleted = false)

**Returned Data:**
- Total, completed, and pending measurement counts
- Measurements with finalized diagnoses
- Recent measurements (last 10, sorted by created_at desc)
- Credit usage from billing ledger
- Monthly activity breakdown

**Credit Calculation:**
- Queries users/{userId}/credits for billing charges
- Filters by type='measurement', settlement_id='', timestamp within period
- Returns 0 if no charges exist (even if measurements exist)
- Charges are created automatically when measurements are locked

**Monthly Activity:**
- Groups measurements by their created_at month
- Credits distributed proportionally across months
- Based on measurement count, not actual charge timestamps

**Why credits might be 0:**
1. No measurements in the query period
2. Measurements exist but billing charges weren't created
3. Query period doesn't match measurement creation dates
4. Measurements older than default 30-day window

**Why measurements might be 0:**
1. Default 30-day range excludes older measurements
2. All measurements are soft-deleted (deleted=true)
3. Genuinely no measurements created yet

parameters.description: Start date for metrics period in ISO 8601 format. Defaults to 30 days before to_date if omitted. Filters measurements by created_at >= this date.

parameters.name: to_date
parameters.description: End date for metrics period in ISO 8601 format. Defaults to current date/time if omitted. Filters measurements by created_at <= this date (inclusive).

get.description:
**Doctor-scoped metrics showing diagnosis performance and workload**

**Default Time Range**: Last 30 days if from_date/to_date not specified

**Access Control**:
Doctors only see measurements where they are dx_edited_by OR dx_signed_by

**Calculation Method**:
1. Queries ALL measurements with deleted=false AND created_at in query period
2. Client-side filters for doctor's UID in dx_edited_by or dx_signed_by fields
3. Calculates diagnosis time as: (dx_date - created_at) in hours

**Note on Performance**:
Currently queries all measurements then filters client-side. May be slow with large datasets.

**Returned Data**:

- Total diagnoses made (measurements where doctor is dx_edited_by/dx_signed_by)
- Completed vs pending diagnosis counts
- Average diagnosis time (hours from creation to diagnosis)
- Diagnosis completion rate percentage
- Monthly diagnosis activity with time trends
- Recent diagnoses (last 10, sorted by dx_date desc)

**Pending Diagnoses Logic**:
- Measurements where locked=true AND dx_locked != true
- Includes assigned_doctor=this_doctor OR assigned_doctor not set
- **Important**: Unassigned locked measurements appear as "pending" for ALL doctors

**Time Period Nuance**:
- Diagnosis counts based on measurements.created_at (when measurement created)
- Diagnosis dates and trends use measurements.dx_date (when diagnosed)
- Average times only include completed diagnoses (dx_locked=true)

**Data Limitations**:
- Patient names hardcoded as "Patient" (needs improvement)
- Doctor names in response hardcoded as "Doctor Name"
- Only includes measurements with both created_at and dx_date timestamps

**Why counts might be 0**:
1. Doctor hasn't edited/signed any measurements in period
2. Default 30-day range excludes older work
3. dx_edited_by/dx_signed_by fields not populated
4. Measurements deleted or outside time range

info.title: Theia Labs Telemedicine API
info.description:
Comprehensive telemedicine platform API for retinal fundus image analysis and diagnosis.

📥 Download OpenAPI Specification

Download JSON Download YAML
## Authentication Methods ### 1. Firebase JWT Authentication - Use Firebase ID tokens for user authentication - Required for doctors, admins, and customers - Include `Authorization: Bearer ` header ### 2. API Key Authentication - Use API keys for system-to-system integration - Include `X-API-Key: ` header - Different permission levels available ### 3. Patient Portal Access - Special authentication for patients to view their results - Uses patient ID and email combination ## Rate Limiting Endpoints are rate-limited to prevent abuse and ensure fair usage: ### Standard Endpoints - **Default limit**: 100 requests per minute - **Applies to**: Most API endpoints - **Headers returned**: `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `X-RateLimit-Reset` ### Resource-Intensive Operations - **Image upload endpoints**: 10 requests per minute - **PDF report generation**: 5 requests per minute - **AI analysis endpoints**: 20 requests per minute ### Rate Limit Headers All responses include rate limit information: - `X-RateLimit-Limit`: Maximum requests allowed in the window - `X-RateLimit-Remaining`: Requests remaining in current window - `X-RateLimit-Reset`: Unix timestamp when the limit resets ### Rate Limit Exceeded Response When rate limit is exceeded, API returns HTTP 429: ```json { "statusCode": 429, "message": "Too Many Requests", "error": "Rate limit exceeded", "retryAfter": 60 } ``` ### Exemptions - Health check endpoints (`/health/*`) are not rate-limited - Authenticated admin users have higher limits ## Error Handling All errors follow RFC 7807 format with consistent structure: ```json { "statusCode": 400, "message": "Validation failed", "error": "Bad Request", "timestamp": "2025-08-02T12:00:00.000Z", "path": "/v1/measurements" } ```

pending_measurements.description: Count where locked != true (from total_measurements). Pending measurements are still being prepared.

measurements_with_diagnosis.description: Count where dx exists AND dx_locked=true (from total_measurements). These measurements have finalized diagnoses.

total_credits_used.description: Sum of credits used by this customer during query period. Queries users/{userId}/credits where type="usage" AND settlement_id="" AND timestamp within period. Returns 0 if no billing charges exist. Charges are automatically created when measurements are locked.

credits_remaining.description: ALWAYS RETURNS 0. Prepaid credit balance not yet implemented.

average_credits_per_measurement.description: Average credits per measurement. Formula: total_credits_used / total_measurements. Returns 0 if no measurements.

total_diagnoses_made.description: Count of measurements where this doctor is listed as dx_edited_by OR dx_signed_by AND deleted=false AND created_at within query period. NOTE: Queries ALL measurements then filters client-side for this doctor.

completed_diagnoses.description: Count where dx_locked=true (from total_diagnoses_made set). Completed diagnoses are finalized and locked.

pending_diagnoses.description: Count of measurements awaiting this doctor where locked=true AND dx_locked != true. Includes assigned_doctor=this_doctor OR unassigned. NOTE: Unassigned locked measurements appear as pending for ALL doctors.

average_diagnosis_time.description: Average time in hours from created_at to dx_date for this doctor's completed diagnoses only. Formula: sum((dx_date - created_at) in ms) / count / (1000*60*60). Only includes dx_locked=true with both timestamps.

diagnosis_completion_rate.description: Percentage of this doctor's diagnoses that are completed. Formula: (completed_diagnoses / total_diagnoses_made) * 100. Returns 0 if no diagnoses.

recent_diagnoses.description: Recent diagnoses made by the doctor
